description.en: A small cat sits in your sidebar: it naps while nothing runs, watches while your agents work and rings when a chat needs you. Click it to open that chat.

tagline.en: A little cat in your sidebar that keeps an eye on your agents

scopes.agent:read: See whether your agents are working.
scopes.agent_chat:read: See which chats wait for your answer or stopped.
scopes.actions:run: Open the chat that waits for you when you click the pet.
